description: Search the reports that covered entities and states have filed about 340B, which the Scorecard holds. Filter by state, year, entity name or 340B ID, entity type, kind of record (an entity's own filing, a row a state printed about an entity, a state's totals) or form. Returns short rows: the entity, state, year, form, kind of record, the ClinX page and the official source. Use get_filing for one report in full. Figures are exactly as filed and ClinX ranks no one.

entity.description: Words in the entity's name as filed or in HRSA's name for it (Ohio's workbooks print an ID and no name), or its city, or a 340B ID such as DSH410009.

entity_type.description: For example hospital, health_center or state_total. about_the_data lists the types held.

form.description: The form's id, as listed by about_the_data.

record_kind.description: For example filing (an entity's own report), state_report_row (a row a state printed about an entity) or state_report_totals. about_the_data lists the kinds held.

state.description: Two-letter state code such as RI or TX. Use US for Congress.

name: find_filings
title: Find filed 340B reports
